items.source: Support base class for singleton registries which need to handle FactoryBean instances, integrated with DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry's singleton management.
items.translation: 支持用于处理需要管理FactoryBean实例的单例注册基类，该基类与DefaultSingletonBeanRegistry的单例管理机制集成。

items.source: Generic registry for shared bean instances, implementing the SingletonBeanRegistry.
items.translation: 用于共享 Bean 实例的通用注册表，实现了 SingletonBeanRegistry 接口。

items.source: Uses of SingletonBeanRegistry in org.springframework.beans.factory.config
items.translation: `SingletonBeanRegistry` 接口在 `org.springframework.beans.factory.config` 包中的使用

items.source: Uses of SingletonBeanRegistry in org.springframework.beans.factory.support
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.beans.factory.support` 包中 `SingletonBeanRegistry` 的用法

items.source: Uses of SingletonBeanRegistry in org.springframework.test.context.bean.override
Abstract base class for BeanFactory implementations, providing the full capabilities of the ConfigurableBeanFactory SPI.
items.translation: `BeanFactory` 实现的抽象基类，提供完整的 `ConfigurableBeanFactory` SPI 功能。

items.source: Spring's default implementation of the ConfigurableListableBeanFactory and BeanDefinitionRegistry interfaces: a full-fledged bean factory based on bean definition metadata, extensible through post-processors.
items.translation: Spring 对 ConfigurableListableBeanFactory 和 BeanDefinitionRegistry 接口的默认实现：一个基于 bean 定义元数据的完整功能 Bean 工厂，可通过后置处理器进行扩展。

items.source: Abstract bean factory superclass that implements default bean creation, with the full capabilities specified by the RootBeanDefinition class.
items.translation: 实现默认 Bean 创建的抽象 BeanFactory 超类，具备由 RootBeanDefinition 类指定的全部功能。

items.source: Track the supplied bean override instance that was created by this BeanOverrideHandler.
items.translation: 跟踪由此 BeanOverrideHandler 创建的 Bean 覆盖实例。

items.source: SPI interfaces and configuration-related convenience classes for bean factories.
items.translation: 用于 Bean 工厂的 SPI 接口和与配置相关的便捷类。

items.source: Support case-by-case Bean overriding in Spring tests.
items.translation: 支持在 Spring 测试中逐案覆盖 Bean。

items.source: Configuration interface to be implemented by most bean factories.
items.translation: 大多数 BeanFactory 需要实现的配置接口。

items.source: Configuration interface to be implemented by most listable bean factories.
items.translation: 大多数可列出 Bean 工厂需要实现的配置接口。
